person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: A CLASSIFICATION CRITERIA SET BUILT FROM A GOLD STANDARD, A DELPHI, A 983-SUBJECT DIAGNOSTIC STUDY AND A DISCRETE-CHOICE CONJOINT EXPERIMENT - and published simultaneously in two journals, in two orthographies
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: how to classify gout for enrolment into studies when the gold standard is available but not feasible, and when every existing criteria set trades sensitivity against specificity badly
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the 2015 ACR/EULAR criteria: an entry criterion, a sufficient criterion, no exclusion criteria, eight weighted domains scored to a maximum of 23 with a threshold of 8, two categories carrying NEGATIVE weights, sensitivity 0.92 and specificity 0.89 in an independent validation set
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: method
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a disease with a gold standard that cannot be applied to most of the people who have it, so the definition has to work without it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: three-phase development: a Delphi of clinicians and patients, the SUGAR cross-sectional diagnostic study (983 subjects, 16 countries, two-thirds derivation and one-third validation), a systematic imaging review, then a 20-member expert panel running discrete-choice conjoint experiments in 1000Minds to weight the domains
span.term: three-phase development: a Delphi of clinicians and patients, the SUGAR cross-sectional diagnostic study (983 subjects, 16 countries, two-thirds derivation and one-third validation), a systematic imaging review, then a 20-member expert panel running discrete-choice conjoint experiments in 1000Minds to weight the domains
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **A CRITERION EXCLUDED FROM THE DEFINITION BECAUSE INCLUDING IT WOULD DESTROY THE ABILITY TO STUDY IT**: `The last three factors [response to treatment, family history, risk factors or associated comorbidities] were NOT CONSIDERED FURTHER as they are NOT FEATURES OF GOUT ITSELF despite their association with gout, and INCLUSION OF RISK FACTORS OR COMORBIDITIES IN THE DEFINITION OF GOUT WOULD PRECLUDE FUTURE STUDIES EVALUATING THEIR ASSOCIATION WITH GOUT.` The clearest statement of definitional circularity in this corpus, and it is a design decision rather than a critique
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE SAME REFUSAL AGAIN, IN THE VALIDATION: `Quotation withheld` **A published sensitivity of 1.00 that is an artefact of the definition, named as such** - and three of the sets in the comparison table carry exactly that 1.00
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND EVIDENCE *AGAINST* MEMBERSHIP IS WEIGHTED, NOT DISCARDED: `there are TWO CATEGORIES THAT ELICIT NEGATIVE SCORES. Specifically, if the synovial fluid is MSU negative, 2 POINTS ARE SUBTRACTED from the total score. Similarly, if the serum urate level is <4 mg/dL, 4 POINTS ARE SUBTRACTED. This approach was taken to emphasise that THESE FINDINGS REDUCE THE PROBABILITY OF GOUT.` A membership score that can go DOWN on evidence - a shape this corpus's `weight` field has no way to express, since weight is bounded below by zero and means confidence, not direction
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **AND A NEGATIVE TEST SCORES THE SAME AS NO TEST, DELIBERATELY**: `In the discrete-choice experiments, Quotation withheld, supporting the validity of using the scoring system in the absence of imaging data.` Our own `absent-not-in-staged-text` problem, in a clinical criteria set - and here the collapse is a decision, taken so that the criteria work where the scanner does not exist
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE WEIGHTS COME FROM A DECISION-SCIENCE EXPERIMENT, NOT FROM A REGRESSION: `the expert panel undertook a series of DISCRETE-CHOICE EXPERIMENTS. This work resulted in weights being assigned to each category and domain, such that THE HIGHEST CATEGORY OF EACH DOMAIN SUMMED TO A TOTAL OF 100%` - pairwise forced choices in 1000Minds, with the panel told to assume all other parameters equal, and face validity checked against their own pre-meeting ranking of ten cases
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND TWO INDEPENDENT ROUTES LANDED ON THE SAME THRESHOLD: `the expert panel performed a threshold identification exercise designed to assess the members' willingness to enrol 47 paper cases ... into a Phase 3 randomised clinical trial of a new urate-lowering agent with unclear efficacy and safety. THE SCORE AT WHICH THE MAJORITY CONSIDERED AN INDIVIDUAL AS HAVING GOUT OR NOT FELL AT THE SAME THRESHOLD AS THAT IDENTIFIED AS THE CUT-OFF SCORE THAT MAXIMISED THE SUM OF SENSITIVITY AND SPECIFICITY.` A statistical optimum and a clinical willingness-to-enrol judgement agreeing - which is the only threshold validation of its kind in this corpus
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND MEMBERSHIP ACCRUES OVER TIME: `the classification was to apply to THE PATIENT'S TOTAL DISEASE EXPERIENCE, NOT TO CLASSIFY INDIVIDUAL SYMPTOMATIC EPISODES ... elements of the criteria COULD BE ACCRUED OVER TIME such that individuals could FULFIL CRITERIA AT A LATER TIME POINT EVEN IF THEY DID NOT AT THE INITIAL ASSESSMENT.` The unit of classification is a life, not a visit - and the categories are `hierarchical and mutually exclusive, such that IF A HIGHER AND A LOWER CATEGORY HAVE BEEN FULFILLED AT DIFFERENT POINTS IN TIME, THE HIGHER ONE SHOULD BE SCORED`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE EMPTY SLOT IS DELIBERATE, WITH ITS REASON: `Quotation withheld` A criteria set that declines to say what rules the disease out, because both the disease and the instrument allow exceptions
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: CRITERIA USED FOR DECADES OUTSIDE THE SCOPE THEIR AUTHORS DECLARED: `Quotation withheld`. The stated scope was narrower than the use, and the correction comes 38 years later from a different body.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND A DEFINITION MADE OBSOLETE BY AN INSTRUMENT THAT DID NOT EXIST WHEN IT WAS WRITTEN: `Quotation withheld.` The criteria did not become wrong; the measurable world grew - which is the same shape as haas2018 admitting i-IFTA because the population changed.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE DEFINITION DISCLAIMS THE USE EVERYONE WILL PUT IT TO: `It should be recognised that Quotation withheld. Thus, in clinical practice, JOINT OR TOPHUS ASPIRATION REMAINS AN ESSENTIAL COMPONENT of establishing a diagnosis of gout.` The criteria exist to assemble study populations, and the paper says so where a reader is most likely to misuse them
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE THRESHOLD SHOULD DIFFER BY PURPOSE, WHILE ONE IS PUBLISHED: `While for certain purposes a HIGHER SENSITIVITY (LOWER SCORE) may be preferable (eg, general population survey to determine the public health burden of gout for resource planning), a HIGHER SPECIFICITY (HIGHER SCORE) may be desirable for others (eg, genetic association studies in which accurate phenotyping is critical).` One number ships; the paper names two uses that want different ones
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE CRITERIA DO NOT TRANSFER TO ANOTHER POPULATION: `classification criteria are NOT INTENDED TO CHARACTERISE THE SEVERITY of disease, BUT ONLY ITS PRESENCE. Additionally, classification criteria SHOULD BE APPLIED ONLY TO THE INTENDED POPULATION - those who meet the entry criteria. PERFORMANCE CHARACTERISTICS OF ANY CLASSIFICATION CRITERIA SET WILL NECESSARILY BE ALTERED IF THE CRITERIA ARE APPLIED TO THOSE OTHER THAN THE INTENDED POPULATION.` The sensitivity and specificity are properties of a pairing, not of the criteria
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE GOLD STANDARD IS NOT USABLE ON MOST PATIENTS: `Quotation withheld.` The reference against which everything is measured cannot be obtained where most of the cases are
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: excluding response to treatment, family history and risk factors/comorbidities from the criteria
span.note: eliminates: a definition that contains its own correlates, which `WOULD PRECLUDE FUTURE STUDIES EVALUATING THEIR ASSOCIATION WITH GOUT` · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.note: eliminates: the circularity that makes several existing criteria sets `100% SENSITIVE BY DEFINITION` · outcome: held

span.label: a threshold identification exercise in which the panel judged willingness to enrol 47 paper cases into a Phase 3 trial, run separately from the statistical cut-off

span.label: `classification criteria` (this paper's sense) - a rule for `enabling STANDARDISED ASSEMBLY OF A RELATIVELY HOMOGENEOUS GROUP of individuals with the disease of interest FOR ENROLMENT INTO STUDIES`, explicitly NOT a diagnostic rule and explicitly not a severity scale
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `entry criterion` / `sufficient criterion` / `exclusion criterion` - three slots defined before any domain: who the criteria apply to, what classifies without scoring, and what rules the disease out. The third was deliberately left EMPTY
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `gold standard` (gout) - MSU crystal positivity: high specificity, inadequate feasibility and sensitivity, and therefore `NOT A FEASIBLE UNIVERSAL STANDARD`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `typical symptomatic episode` - and the SAME criterion reads differently in the twin: `irrespective of ANTI-INFLAMMATORY treatment ... <24 h` in Annals, `irrespective of ANTIINFLAMMATORY treatment ... <24 hours` in Arthritis & Rheumatology. One criterion, two orthographies, two DOIs
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `preliminary criteria` - A PROVISIONAL LABEL THAT NEVER EXPIRED: `the MOST WIDELY USED being the 1977 American Rheumatism Association (NOW the American College of Rheumatology (ACR)) PRELIMINARY criteria`. The word `preliminary` is still in the name in 2015, the issuing society has since changed its own name, and the criteria remain the field's default.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: extends → the 1977 American Rheumatism Association preliminary criteria for the classification of the acute arthritis of primary gout, whose gold standard was PHYSICIAN DIAGNOSIS rather than crystal status, and the Rome, New York, Mexico and Netherlands criteria sets measured alongside it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: extends → ITS OWN TWIN: the identical criteria set published simultaneously as doi:10.1002/art.39254 in Arthritis & Rheumatology (PMC4566153). Same 22 authors, same year, same criteria, BRITISH spelling here and AMERICAN there - one artefact with two DOIs and two citation counts
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.note: the relation itself is separately evidenced · strength of the relation: 0.95 — `It should be recognised that Quotation withheld. Thus, in clinical practice, joint or tophus aspiration remains an essential component of establishing a diagnosis of gout.` A definition naming a use it will not support, in the place a reader is most likely to misuse it

span.note: the relation itself is separately evidenced · strength of the relation: 0.85 — `In the discrete-choice experiments, Quotation withheld.` Weight 0.85: this is an equivalence IN THE INSTRUMENT, adopted so the criteria work where imaging is unavailable - not a claim that an absent test and a negative test are the same thing. It is our own `absent-not-in-staged-text` collapse, made deliberately and for a stated reason
